message:
@.devcatrc is supposed to say what files to exclude from context being fed to LLMs. Is there anything in this
   repo we should exclude or is it all important?
I think we still are pulling some un-needed data. Use devcat yourself to see what we're picking up!

Add an option to run this with gemini CLI instead of claude CLI ``` $ gemini -h

Gemini CLI - Defaults to interactive mode. Use -p/--prompt for non-interactive

  gemini hooks <command>       Manage Gemini CLI hooks.                                           [aliases: hook]

                                                       [string] [choices: "default", "auto_edit", "yolo", "plan"]

Launch the proces using gemini for 5 minutes. Iterate until it works as expected. Then launch for 5 hours.
